text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I say of the LORD: He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.
Surely he will deliver you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly plague.
He will cover you with his pinions, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
nor the plague that stalks in the darkness, nor the pestilence that ravages at noon.
A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
You will only look with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

versions.text: You will only look on with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
versions.explanation: "Look on with your eyes" is slightly awkward for oral reading; dropping "on" matches the Hebrew (תַבִּיט, "you will look") and flows better.

text: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, the Most High your dwelling place,

versions.text: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, the Most High your dwelling,
versions.explanation: The Hebrew reads literally "For you, O LORD, are my refuge; you have made the Most High your dwelling," with a shift of speaker. The smoothed rendering is defensible, but a footnote noting the literal Hebrew would help the reader; also "dwelling place" reads more naturally aloud in parallel with "refuge."

text: no disaster will overtake you, no plague will come near your tent.
For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
You will tread on the lion and the cobra; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.
"Because he clings to me in love, I will rescue him; I will lift him high, for he knows my name.
He will call on me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.
With long life I will satisfy him, and I will show him my salvation."
